spec.goal: Add a frozen-only auto-center action that repositions drag-region frozen selections around detected content without changing selection size.
success_criteria: After entering Frozen mode from a drag-region capture, the Frozen toolbar exposes an auto-center action and pressing `c` in Frozen mode triggers the same action.
Auto-center only repositions `state.frozen_capture_rect`; width and height remain unchanged for the whole action.
The auto-center heuristic uses the frozen image to estimate meaningful content and shifts the rect toward horizontal and vertical centering while staying clamped to the frozen monitor bounds.
If no reliable content target is detected, the action leaves the rect unchanged instead of jumping unpredictably.
Manual frozen dragging, export cropping, toolbar placement, and scroll-preview placement remain synchronized with the adjusted rect.
constraints: The toolbar entry only exists in Frozen mode; do not introduce a live-mode control for this action.
Keep the feature scoped to the existing frozen drag-region flow unless broader support falls out naturally without extra branching.
Do not add resize behavior, multi-monitor movement, or new final-capture semantics.
Follow repo-native verification via cargo make tasks before claiming completion.

tasks.title: Add a frozen auto-center heuristic and rect adjustment helper
tasks.objective: Ground a deterministic auto-center action in the current frozen image so the session can shift the existing drag-region frozen rect without resizing it.
inputs: Existing frozen rect move/clamp helpers in `OverlaySession`
Frozen image crop/export behavior keyed off `state.frozen_capture_rect`
outputs: A helper that inspects the frozen image and estimates a meaningful content target for the current drag-region selection
A rect-adjustment path that preserves width/height, clamps to the frozen monitor, and no-ops on weak detections
verification: The heuristic can produce a repositioned rect for asymmetric content while leaving size unchanged.
Missing image / unsupported frozen source / low-confidence detections resolve to no-op behavior instead of invalid rect changes.

tasks.title: Wire the action into Frozen toolbar and keyboard handling
tasks.objective: Expose the new auto-center action only in Frozen mode through the existing toolbar action pipeline and a `c` shortcut.
inputs: Frozen toolbar tool enumeration and action dispatch
Toolbar placement update path used by frozen drag moves
outputs: A Frozen toolbar button for auto-center
A Frozen-mode `c` shortcut that triggers the same rect adjustment path
Toolbar/preview redraw updates that follow the adjusted rect
verification: Toolbar and keyboard trigger the same auto-center behavior.
The action remains unavailable outside Frozen mode and does not break existing `s`, `space`, or toolbar flows.

tasks.title: Add focused regression coverage for auto-center and no-op boundaries
tasks.objective: Lock down the content-aware reposition behavior, clamping, and guardrails so future frozen UX changes do not regress XY-161.
inputs: New auto-center helper behavior from task-1
Toolbar tool visibility/dispatch behavior from task-2
outputs: Regression tests for asymmetric content centering, no-op fallback cases, rect clamping, and toolbar action exposure
verification: New tests fail when the action or heuristic is missing and pass on the final implementation.

tasks.title: Run repo-native verification and record execution evidence
tasks.objective: Validate the finished XY-161 implementation with the repo-native gates and update the saved execution state with fresh evidence.
outputs: Updated plan runtime state reflecting the completed implementation

triggers: The frozen image does not provide enough signal for a deterministic content-centering heuristic without widening scope into OCR or external vision.
Toolbar exposure requires a broader frozen-tool taxonomy change instead of a local action addition.
Verification reveals that downstream frozen-rect consumers need architectural changes beyond the current overlay session ownership.

evidence: Task 1 outcome: `OverlaySession` now detects salient content bounds from the current frozen crop using edge-sampled background contrast and converts that content-centering delta back into a clamped point-space rect move without resizing.
Task 2 outcome: Frozen drag-region selections now expose an `AutoCenter` toolbar action with the `TARGET` icon, and pressing plain `c` / `C` in Frozen mode routes to the same rect-adjustment path.
Task 2 guardrail: the auto-center toolbar slot appears only when the current Frozen state is a drag-region selection with frozen pixels available; fullscreen/window frozen flows remain unchanged.
Task 3 outcome: added regression tests for scale-aware auto-centering, uniform-crop no-op behavior, toolbar action visibility, and toolbar-size stability while final frozen-capture readiness changes.
Task 4 verification: `cargo test -p rsnap-overlay --lib auto_center` passed with 3 tests passing and 0 failures.
Task 4 verification: `cargo test -p rsnap-overlay --lib drag_region_toolbar_size_stays_stable_while_final_capture_readiness_changes` passed with 1 test passing and 0 failures.
Task 4 verification: `cargo make lint-fix` completed successfully.

Task 4 verification: `cargo make test` completed successfully.
